notes: Web 444 — DSP-PHOTO-HEAL-NOV12 (Nov 12, 2026; layers on web 443). Owner evidence (17:52 CST, his screenshot of Dispatch > History): the completed Nov 9 Aecon card shows its haul-card photo; the completed Nov 11 card (#28846, $348.00) and Nov 10 card (#28830, $217.50) show NO picture — his question: "Why are there no pictures on this?" ROOT: every save/close/edit of a dispatch writes the FULL record, card photo included, to the account per-record copy (fbSave -> users/{uid}/dispatches/{id}), but no code anywhere read that collection back — fuel (web 426) and documents (web 442) heal photo-less records from their account copies, dispatch never got its heal, so a completed record whose list copy arrived photo-less stayed photo-less on every History card while its photo sat in the account copy. FIX (modules/dispatch.js ONLY): on render, a completed record with no photo dspPhotoFor can find — or only a vault reference the vault cannot produce — is looked up in its account copy; a photo found there is restored onto the record (into the vault first when the bytes are inline, so the record carries a reference; onto the same ticket it rode in the copy, or the number-matching / last ticket, or the top level when the record has no tickets) and saved through the module’s own write doors (W + fbSave), so the photo then rides the record itself on every surface. Photo field only — hours, amounts and every other fact never move. A per-session ledger with a 5-minute retry window bounds the reads (the fuel graft ledger’s shape); records holding a photo and open records are never looked up. BENCH: new tools/dsp-photo-heal-nov12-test.js 34/34 on this tree (Nov 10 one-ticket shape, Nov 11 no-ticket shape, split two-ticket shape, dead-reference replacement, healthy-reference and with-photo guards, open records untouched, photo-less copy inert, reload persistence, no-FB safety); failing-first on pristine 442 the same suite fails every heal assertion (19 passed / 15 failed) — the records stay photo-less, the owner’s exact symptom. REGRESSION vs pristine 443: dispatch-close 77/79, dispatch-completed 64/65, dispatch-edit 81/82, dispatch-delete 15/15, close-echo-nov12 25/25, photovault-v441 36/36, docview-v442 45/45, docpick-v443 53/53 — every count identical; the standing dispatch dialog-count era failure is unchanged, and the three dispatch ?v= pin checks that failed on pristine now PASS (this release’s pin move). PIN MOVES: index.html modules/dispatch.js 429 -> 444; version.json via build-ota --bump (444). NO NATIVE CHANGE. VERDICT OWED IN HIS HANDS: once Preferences reads web 444, Dispatch > History — a completed card whose photo lives in its account copy shows the photo on its own; the Nov 10 card (#28830) is expected to heal itself this way. The Nov 11 card (#28846) is separate: that close was finished from the web copy, which never held the photo he attached on his phone, so no app copy of it exists — its verified card photo is restored onto the record by hand through the app (photo file haul-card-2026-11-11-aecon-28846.jpg, card number read in the image).
